WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT k AS "probe_key", v AS "probe_value" FROM a ORDER BY k

WITH a AS (SELECT sales."channelKey" AS k, MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS v FROM sales WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2007-02-01' AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2007-03-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT k AS "探针维度", v AS "探针数值", CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS BIGINT) AS "探针序号" FROM a ORDER BY k
